scope: Bounded primary-literature support for explaining the existing surrogate-HMC experiment and candidate repairs; not an exhaustive review or method promotion.

source_support.title: MCMC using Hamiltonian dynamics
source_support.version: arXiv v1, 2012-06-09; PDF states Handbook of Markov Chain Monte Carlo chapter 5, 2011
sections_checked: 5.5: approximate Hamiltonian trajectories and exact endpoint correction
supports: approximate trajectories with reversible volume-preserving map and declared endpoint correction
one-step gradient HMC equals Gaussian drift MH
limits: arbitrary nonconservative-field invariance is the local translation/involution derivation, not attributed to this chapter

source_support.title: Gradient-free Hamiltonian Monte Carlo with Efficient Kernel Exponential Families
source_support.version: arXiv v2, 2015-11-24; published venue metadata not independently checked
supports: learned kernel field can guide trajectories corrected against target endpoint
limits: optional future method, not current DCTR implementation
author code linked at https://github.com/karlnapf/kernel_hmc but not audited
no general ergodicity or runtime claim

source_support.title: Rank-normalization, folding, and localization: An improved R-hat for assessing convergence of MCMC
source_support.version: arXiv v5, 2021-06-22; venue metadata not independently checked
sections_checked: sections 3-4, especially rank/fold and localized indicator diagnostics
supports: R-hat and rank ESS are useful screens but quantity-specific MCSE is necessary
ESS 400 is intended to stabilize uncertainty estimation, not guarantee .02 CDF equivalence
limits: Appendix A simulation suite not independently reproduced
no claim any diagnostic proves convergence

source_support.title: Lugsail lag windows for estimating time-average covariance matrices
source_support.version: arXiv v3, 2021-07-11; PDF manuscript date 2021-07-13; venue metadata not independently checked
supports: lugsail estimator as candidate to address downward covariance-estimation bias
batch consistency conditions require both batch length and number of batches to grow
limits: no choice of lugsail tuning or diagnostic cutoff promoted
not a solution to nonstationarity or missing modes

source_support.title: The pseudo-marginal approach for efficient Monte Carlo computations
source_support.version: arXiv v1, 2009-03-31; Annals of Statistics 37(2):697-725; DOI 10.1214/07-AOS574 verified in PDF
supports: nonnegative unbiased likelihood weight and augmented estimator state yield the intended parameter marginal
limits: fixed-bank DCTR posterior is not the pseudo-marginal construction
